summary: The first mismatch follows the missing pray.c:desecrate_altar call from music.c:do_earthquake. C applies alignment anger, emits altar-desecration messages and a god voice, then calls god_zaps_you; JS music.js currently records the missing helper and continues to do_pit. The same helper also has active altar-destruction and high-altar sacrifice callers in dig.c and pray.c.

source.branch: When an earthquake changes a non-sanctum ALTAR, music.c:do_earthquake derives its alignment and calls desecrate_altar(FALSE, alignment) before do_pit. The helper lowers alignment and adds anger when the altar matches the hero, then emits charged-air and deity-noticed messages, calls godvoice with text selected by highaltar, and calls god_zaps_you. Other direct callers pass TRUE for qualifying high-altar sacrifice paths; dig.c:digactualhole passes FALSE after hero-caused altar damage.

evidence: The saved v47 baseline evaluation at challenges/evaluations/baseline-a6e3a17cc-v47.json records the first screen mismatch at segment 0, step 195 (row 0, column 37: C "-", JS space) for case v47-earthquake-desecrates-generated-altar; its first RNG mismatch is at step 197, where C reports rn2(4)=2 from pray.c:godvoice while JS reports rn2(13)=3.

nethack-c/upstream/src/music.c:do_earthquake (ALTAR arm, around lines 419-430) calls desecrate_altar(FALSE, algn) before creating the pit. nethack-c/upstream/src/pray.c:desecrate_altar (lines 1501-1522) conditionally calls adjalign(-20), increments u.ugangr, emits the charged-air and noticed messages, calls godvoice, and calls god_zaps_you.

The active direct callers are music.c:do_earthquake, dig.c:digactualhole (around line 721), pray.c:offer_negative_valued (around line 1595), pray.c:sacrifice_your_race (around line 1715), and pray.c:dosacrifice (around line 2021). Their JS source sites currently call note_unported for pray.c:desecrate_altar in music.js, dig.js, and pray.js; implementation must replace all those active placeholders.

The return value of no dependency is consumed by desecrate_altar. Existing JS owners provide adjalign, align_gname, godvoice, and god_zaps_you. The selected v47 recording covers the earthquake call with highaltar=false; separate matching recordings are still needed for the dig caller and a qualifying high-altar sacrifice route before claiming all impure entry-point evidence.
